weeks Expedited: 2-3 weeks A passport is a document issued by the federal government and certifies the identity and nationality of the passport holder. A passport has two physical forms: Passport Book - can be used for air, land and sea travel. Passport Card - can be used for domestic flight travel, and to travel to and return from Canada, Mexico, the Caribbean and Bermuda at land border crossing or sea ports-of-entry. To obtain a passport, applicants must apply in person at an authorized Passport Acceptance Facility which includes the Fillmore County Auditor/Treasurer's Office. Additional information is also available at travel.state.gov . How to Apply for a New Passport Book or Card Complete the application for a U.S. passport in BLACK INK or print out the completed application as a ONE SIDED document. If mistakes are made on the application, make a single line through the incorrect section and write what was intended. DO NOT sign the application until an Acceptance Agent asks you to do so . Applications are also available at the Fillmore County Auditor/Treasurer's office. Passport applications completed for minors under the age of 16 are required to have both parents or guardians present and have their identification provided to complete the application process. Passports have an life duration of 5 years before renewal and applicants will need to apply as a minor until they turn 16 years of age. For more information, visit the Travel.State.Gov site page "Apply for a Child Under 16" Passport applications completed for applicants ages 16 and 17, they may apply for the application on their own, however, it is recommended that one parent or guardian be present to sign along with the applicant. This is to show that the parent or guardian is aware that the application is applying for a passport. For more information, visit the Travel.State.Gov site page "Apply as a 16 or 17 Year Old" Submit original proof of U.S. citizenship (one of the following): Certified birth certificate (within the U.S. - must be issued by the County or State of birth - hospital issued or church created certificates of birth WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED ) Consular Report of Birth Abroad or Certification of Birth Naturalization Certificate Certificate of Citizenship Previously issued, undamaged U.S. Passport More information can be found on the Travel.State.Gov website Proof of Identification Valid Minnesota Driver's License (If you have a driver's license from a state other than MN, please bring a second form of photo ID) Clipped Minnesota Driver's License with white renewal receipt Naturalization Certificate Current Government ID (city, state or federal) Previously issued, undamaged U.S. Passport Current Military ID (military and dependents) Out-of-state Driver's License or ID requires - Secondary Identification . More information can be found on the Travel.State.Gov website Photograph Photos services are available at the Fillmore County Auditor-Treasurer office for an additional $15.00 each. Photos taken at an outside location MUST MEET THE QUALITY REQUIRMENTS set by the U.S. Department of State - click here Photos must be taken within 6 months of submitting the application NOTE: If a photo taken at an outside location does not meet the requirements, a new photo will be taken and the $15.00 fee will be charged Two forms of payment must be brought to the Acceptance Agency with at least one (1) being a check or money order. U.S. Department of State A check or money order payable to the U.S. Department of State must be written out for federal processing fee including: Passport style fee: $30.00 (card) or $130.00 (book) Expedited Processing fees: $60.00 per application Cash/Debit or Credit Cards are not accepted as payment for these fees at this time County Fees Fillmore County collects a separate payment for processes conducted through the application process including: Processing Fee (set by U.S. Department of State): $35.00 per application Photograph: $15.00 per photo Copies: $1.00 Payments may be made via Cash/Check/Money Order/Debit or Credit Card payable to the Fillmore County Auditor-Treasurer Card payments are subject to a 3% non-refundable processing fee. Payments $33 or less will have a flat $1.00 fee How to Renew a Passport Book or Card **Passports have a grace period of 5 years after expiration to be renewed. If your passport is after this grace period, follow the steps for a New Passport Application above.** To apply for a renewal, complete the renew application for a U.S. passport either online (printed single-sided ) or in-person (filled out in black ink ), provide your expired/expiring passport card or book, a check or money order to the US Department of State for the amount of your book or card (see above for prices), and have an updated photo taken. Once complete, our office will provide a Priority shipping envelope for all your documents to be mailed to the National Passport agency. Fees and timelines are the same as a new application. To track your application or ask any questions after mailing your documents, please contact the National Passport Agency at travel.state.gov . THE COUNTY IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE ASSISTANCE AFTER THE APPLICATION HAS BEEN MAILED. Share this page × Share this page Copy and paste this code into your website.
